snippet.title: IFSCL 4.8.X Trailer - Code Lyoko Game
snippet.description:
The IFSCL is an ambitious solo game project developed since 2010, an interface simulator and Jeremy POV adventure game.
PLAY NOW: https://ifscl.org/
DISCORD: https://ifscl.org/discord
PATREON: https://ifscl.org/patreon

MUSIC: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mbh0THF78k8&list=PLim3m5NnkYFcixQ7oybiOodMb4IrTLd_A&index=65

What a day to be a Lyoko Fan! If IFSCL was a bit behind in 2025, so many fan projects got released! But don't do the mistake. I'll always be there.

Many thanks to all the Patreons, your support allows me to work on those peacefully!
